reason: l_sig was classified EFFECTIVELY_BOUNDED on a 3-security sample showing 100% L-digit coverage. A full-store census refutes it.

CENSUS.method: count bars with age>=20 (bounded requirement met) where NO L-digit L1..L6 is active — those bars fall through to the named fallback list

rule.bar has an active L-digit: BOUNDED depth 20 — the ascending-digit concat path
rule.bar has no active L-digit: falls through to the named list (FRI34, BLUE, CCI_*, BE_UP, BO_UP, BX_UP, FUCHSIA_*, PRE_PUMP) and therefore INHERITS the anchored/unbounded carrier requirement of bo_up/bx_up/be_up on that row

significance: 47 of 5,846,542 is negligible for support but NOT for correctness: treating those rows as bounded would assert a value the state does not license. The rule is per-row, not per-column.
note: the check tested all six digits L1..L6, matching the l_chart producer loop range(1,7) — not only L34/L22/L43
